messages:
alex_li: Opening thread — dedicated-eu3 reporting allocation failures and growing queues, routers returning 503s for some orgs. Triage in progress.

maria_chen: Confirmed. GPU pool at 99.4% memory used, scheduler failing to bind new tasks. Sample log: `pod-assign error: no free device (alloc failure)`

benji: Kicking off hosted bridge to take pressure. Running: `redwoodctl routing set-weight --region eu3 --from dedicated --to hosted --pct 25` — will do incremental ramps.

ops-bot: Runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-fallback — checklist added (notify-CS, prewarm-cache, scale-dedicated).

tariq_k: Heads-up — moving traffic to hosted will cold-start KV caches and could spike tail latency. Proposal: prewarm top orgs and temporarily reduce batching to lower queue depth.

maria_chen: Started prewarm for top-5 orgs (orgA, orgB, orgC, orgD, orgE). Prewarm job id: `prewarm-191234` ETA ~8m.

sre-bot: Metrics snapshot: dedicated-eu3 queue_length=420 (baseline ~10), allocation_failures=183 in last 5m. hosted-eu3 queue_length jumped 18 -> 140.

benji: Hosted bridge update after first ramp: weight 25% applied. Hosted CPU +15%, memory +8%. 95th latency increased by ~90ms but still within soft SLO for now.

maria_chen: Applied short-term scheduler change on dedicated: `scheduler.batch_ms=30` to reduce head-of-line wait and free slots quicker. Rolling deploy started (`deploy-config --service scheduler --set batch-ms=30`).

alex_li: CS notify: @customer-success please prepare a proactive note for impacted customers (top traffic orgs). If we can't stabilize dedicated in 30m, we'll request permission to keep bridge at higher weight.

customer-success-bot: CS thread created: https://redwood.internal/cs/threads/1912345678 — assigned to @maria_chen and @benji for impact details.

benji: Quick cost heads-up: current 25% shift to hosted estimated to add ~$750/hr. Finance looped in via #finance-alerts.

tariq_k: Provision request submitted for +4 dedicated GPUs in eu3 (request id q-8372). ETA ~45m due to placement/quota checks. If provisioning stalls, we should plan gradual ramp to 60% hosted.

maria_chen: Prewarm jobs reporting partial hits; latency for prewarmed keys improving. Continuing to monitor heatmap for top orgs.

alex_li: Plan summary: 1) Ramp hosted to 25% (done) -> monitor 2) Prewarm top orgs (in progress) 3) Tweak batching on dedicated (done) 4) Provision +4 GPUs (in flight) 5) If dedicated not healthy in 45m, ramp hosted to 60% and escalate to infra leads. Posting periodic updates here. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Next automated check scheduled in 5m.

benji: Added temp dashboard link: https://metrics.redwood.internal/dashboards/eu3-capacity-1912345678

alex_li: Leaving monitoring 10m blocks. Ping me if any of these deviate >20% from current.
